issue.title: Start lean: `=~<K>` drops queued Task Links as the next Pomodoro starts
issue.description: `bob capture '=~2'` starts today's next Pomodoro without queued Task Link 2. It also works as `=<X>~<K>` and `=<X>#name~<K>`, in blank-line batches, and in same-line chains such as `=x =~2`. It is atomic and dry-runnable. Every start shows its numbered lineup, so you can see which number to drop. `capture-parse` and `capture-complete` support the new token, and Bob Mac Capture shows a numbered, drop-aware start card.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202609/start_drop_queued_links.md requests this work

issue.title: bob-cli: numbered start lineup and the drop engine
issue.description: start-lineup: number every whole-item start's queued Task Links (`tasks[].index`, `tasks[].now`, a numbered human index column). Build the pure drop engine: validate numbers against the lineup, remove each dropped Task Link subtree byte-exactly, and report `drop`/`dropped` plus duplicate warnings. Plumb a `drop` list through both start planners, with no grammar yet.

issue.title: bob-cli: `=[<X>][#name]~<K>` grammar, editor support, and docs
issue.description: start-drop-grammar: lex the trailing `~<K>` drop list on whole-item starts. Wire it through `bob capture` (execution, batches, chains) into the start-lineup engine. Mirror it in `capture-parse` (the `pomodoro_start_drop` span, the `pomodoro_start_task` need, incomplete states, precise diagnostics) and in `capture-complete`. Document the gesture everywhere.

issue.title: Bob Mac Capture: numbered, drop-aware start card
issue.description: mac-start-drop: decode the new start fields tolerantly. Preview a dangling `~`/`,` as a dimmed pending start with Start disabled. Add real-bob fixtures, tests, and README updates, gated by green macOS CI.
